description: Declares which WordNet synsets stand for which entity types. A WordNet sense belongs to the entity type of the nearest anchor among its ancestors (hypernym and instance edges), so a singer, reached through 'musician' before 'person', counts as music_artist. Brain.Lexicon.Seeder uses this to turn SemCor sense counts into per-type usage counts for each word. Each anchor names a word its synset must contain; loading fails if WordNet no longer agrees, so a changed WordNet release cannot silently re-point an anchor. Types absent from this table have no WordNet evidence at all, which is different from evidence of zero use.
